Question: I accidentally spilled a few drops (probably 1 gram or little more) of mercury in my car. I tried to clean but couldn't find it. Is there any danger if I drive car with windows closed?
Answer: You didn’t say where you spilled it in the car. A few drops of mercury aren’t going to emit enough hazardous vapors at the temperatures typically seen in a car. You’d have to travel in the desert, with the windows up, for years, to be in danger. There is a modicum of hazard for children dropping food on it, or the carwash detailing people coming upon it, etc., so do a more concerted job of locating the mercury. Not knowing where it is or how it was spilled, it would be hard to make search and cleanup suggestions.

Question: If someone drank nic salt, what would happen to them?
Answer: That depends on what you mean by “nic salt”. The stuff that comes for use in vape pens or similar devices would probably make the person vomit or result in a nicotine overdose. How serious that overdose could be would depend on the amount swallowed. If you’re meaning the nicotine salt acid extracts that make up industrial chemicals and some insect poisons it would quite probably be “lights out” for the person drinking it.

Question: Does abrasion on a paracord knife handle matter? Is it going to wear out anyway?
Answer: Yes, a paracord-wrapped knife handle will wear out, get cut, or just get so nasty that it has to be replaced. One of my neck knives came with a bright orange wrap that shows the tiniest amount of dirt right away. That one’s about to get re-wrapped in black. Just get some paracord from an outfitter store or Amazon and watch the videos on YouTube about wrapping with paracord. Then do it. If your blade is quite sharp, it’s a good idea to tape the sharp edge with heavy masking tape to avoid an accidental nick in your hand while wrapping.

Question: Which pipe style does Teflon tape work best on, metal or plastic pipe?
Answer: Teflon tape works OK on steel pipe. Unfortunately, amateurs are prone to overwrapping and also creating stray Teflon bits and blockages when they misuse the tape. I banned it in my factory. Every use of Teflon tape that I’ve seen on plastic pipe was over wrapped and over-tightened. Some of the fittings actually failed in use from overtightening. Generally, Teflon tape is for lazy people or amateurs. Even you famous extra special people who have already answered this question and sung the praises of that crap.
